_comment: Snapshot of the LIVE menu (Supabase project 'Hioc Coffee'). Recipes in data/inventory/recipes/ must reference these ids and size labels exactly. Refresh with `npm run inventory:snapshot` (needs service-role env) or ask the chef agent. Do not hand-edit.

items.name: Mixed Berry Cheesecake
items.description: Mixed Berry Cheesecake is a creamy cheesecake topped with a tangy mixed-berry compote.

items.name: Mango Cheesecake
items.description: Mango Cheesecake is a creamy cheesecake topped with ripe, sweet mango.

items.name: Biscoff Cheesecake
items.description: Biscoff Cheesecake is a creamy cheesecake with a Lotus Biscoff biscuit base and a caramelised Biscoff topping.

items.name: Oreo Cheesecake
items.description: Oreo Cheesecake is a creamy cheesecake packed with crushed Oreo cookies on a chocolate-cookie base.

items.name: Newyork Style Cheesecake
items.description: New York Style Cheesecake is a classic dense, creamy baked cheesecake on a biscuit base.

items.name: Hioc's Signature Tiramisu
items.description: Hioc's Signature Tiramisu layers coffee-soaked sponge with light mascarpone cream and a dusting of cocoa.

items.name: Signature Iced Brew
items.description: Signature Iced Brew is a meticulously brewed cold coffee, steeped for 18-24 hours to extract a rich, smooth flavor. Served over ice, it delivers a refreshingly bold and naturally sweet coffee experience without the bitterness.

items.name: Vanilla Creme Cold Brew
items.description: Vanilla Crème Cold Brew is a smooth, rich cold brew coffee, steeped for 18-24 hours and infused with a hint of vanilla, topped with a creamy, velvety finish for a refreshing and indulgent experience.

items.name: Toffee Nut Cold Brew
items.description: Toffee Nut Cold Brew is a smooth, rich cold brew coffee, steeped for 18-24 hours, infused with the sweet flavors of caramel and a hint of hazelnut, topped with a creamy finish for a deliciously nutty and indulgent experience.

items.name: Choco Chip Cupcake
